reason: My diary and the phone work fine and I know every customer by face. I will not hand my udhaar records to something I have not seen work in a shop like mine, and I do not know what happens after the free 3 months.
objection: Is 500 rupees a month worth it, and what happens after the free 3 months? If it picks up a wrong order or loses my udhaar, who answers for it?
would_change_my_mind: Another kirana owner I know personally showing me it running in his shop, plus a clear promise that the khata stays mine and nothing is charged after 3 months unless I say yes.
